summary: Ground-level L-4 cabin in the Bob Marshall Wilderness, Flathead NF; built 1930, still there in 1956, since removed. No site description found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. Firelookout.com says it was still there in 1956 and has since departed; Montanalookouts lists it as removed with no date.

events.note: firelookout.com: L-4 cab built in 1930, replacing an earlier camp
firelookout.com: still standing in 1956; removal date not given by any source read

evidence.quote: Located in the Bob Marshall Wilderness, this L-4 cab, built in 1930, replaced an earlier camp.
It was still there in 1956, but has since departed.

notes_for_editor: Brief checked: kind ground (an L-4 cab), status gone and Flathead NF agree with the sources; no corrections. Only firelookout.com dates the cabin (1930) and its 1956 presence; no source gives a removal date. Montanalookouts and the FFLA list say removed or ground gone with no date. The Flathead Beacon piece is about the forest generally and does not name Kid Mountain, so the story says so. A 2025 FFLA social-media post (seen only as a search snippet, not read) shows the cabin in a flyby photo and spells the name 'Kid (Kidd?)'; the Facebook page did not return text, so it is not cited. firelookout.com credits a Fire Lookout Museum photo with no URL, so no photo entry was added. Worth checking: Flathead NF archives, and the FFLA post for its photo credit and date.
